definition: Applicants who started sign-up in the app in the month
formula: count of applicants whose signup_started event falls in the month (Malaysia time)

definition: Accounts opened in the month
formula: count of customers by the month their account opened

definition: Share of the month's applicants who went on to open an account
formula: applicants who reached account_opened / applicants who started, by start month

definition: Share of applicants who scanned their MyKad and then passed the selfie liveness check
formula: liveness passed / MyKad scanned, by start month

definition: Acquisition marketing spend per account opened
formula: acquisition spend / new customers; blank while an invoice is missing

definition: Share of customers who opened three months earlier and made a transaction themselves this month
formula: customers active in their third month after opening / customers in that cohort

definition: Customers who made at least one transaction themselves in the month
formula: count of customers with a transfer out, bill payment, card purchase or FD placement

definition: Share of customers with an open account who were active in the month
formula: monthly active customers / customers with an open account at month end

definition: Transactions active customers made themselves, per customer
formula: customer-initiated transactions / monthly active customers

definition: Share of the month's new customers with a debit card who activated it within 30 days of opening
formula: cards activated within 30 days / new customers issued a card

definition: Card purchases settled and posted to the ledger in the month
formula: sum of card purchase postings (RM)

definition: Share of card authorisation attempts approved
formula: approved authorisations (response 00) / all authorisations

definition: Savings (CASA) and fixed deposit balances at month end
formula: sum of month-end deposit balances (RM)

definition: Share of deposits held in current and savings accounts rather than fixed deposits
formula: CASA balance / total deposits at month end

definition: Annualised interest cost of deposits
formula: interest accrued on average balances / average deposits x 365 / days in month

definition: Share of matured fixed deposit money still with the bank 30 days after maturity
formula: (money rolled over + money paid to savings and not transferred out within 30 days) / money matured, by maturity month

definition: Personal financing principal outstanding at month end
formula: sum of outstanding principal on active loans (RM)

definition: Personal financing paid out in the month
formula: sum of principal disbursed (RM)

definition: Share of the loan book 30 or more days past due
formula: outstanding principal on loans 30+ days past due / gross loans

definition: Share of the loan book impaired, meaning more than 90 days past due
formula: outstanding principal on loans more than 90 days past due / gross loans

definition: Share of the loans disbursed six months earlier that have ever been 30+ days past due
formula: loans ever 30+ days past due by month on book 6 / loans in that vintage

definition: Interest earned on performing financing less interest accrued on deposits
formula: loan interest income - deposit interest expense (RM, accrual basis)
